integrity: Mathematical assertion checked by full derivation and reproduced exact symbolic identities; finite-support experiments are supplementary. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact one-stage Euclidean damping of autonomous damped rotations under prescribed mean nonnegative timestep, not error at fixed physical time or work-normalized speed. Zero-step support is needed for attainment in the randomized regime; strictly positive timesteps have only an infimum there. Historical equivalence remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp fixed-mean randomized backward-Euler damping on a planar oscillator
